name: FieldShell
description: The frame every text and choice field is built on: a label row with icon actions at its end, the control, then a status message and a helper line.

keyboard: Label-row actions come before the control in Tab order, as they sit above it.
An action with items opens a menu on Enter, Space or ArrowDown; arrow keys move through the items and Escape closes it.
ariaRequirements: The label is a <label for> the control and carries the id `${controlId}-label` for controls named with aria-labelledby.
The control's aria-describedby lists the status message and then the helper line (fieldDescribedBy builds it).
An error message is announced as an alert; aria-invalid is set by the control only for status error.
Each action is an icon button named by its label, which is also its tooltip.
a11y.reviewedNote: 2026-10-30 (Claude, Storybook 6010, Chromium; real key presses): label is a <label for> the control and carries ${id}-label for aria-labelledby controls (Combobox, MultiCombobox); fieldDescribedBy lists the status message then the helper (verified on Company size: named by its label, described by 'Choose a company size', aria-invalid only for error). Actions: native buttons named by aria-label; DS Tooltip opens on keyboard focus (Shift+Tab onto Paste shows 'Paste'), not pointer-only. Menu action: Enter opens, ArrowDown moves Use-the-size-from-last-time -> Reset, Escape closes and returns focus to the trigger; aria-haspopup=menu, aria-expanded tracks state. Focus ring sits inside the 32px box, 4px clear of the control (measured). Hit area 44px on coarse pointers. No motion of its own; Menu and Tooltip carry the DS reduced-motion handling. Forced colors: icon ButtonText, ring Highlight 3px inset. The label is always required; hideLabel hides it visually and keeps it as the accessible name.

forbiddenUse: wrap a DS field (TextInput, TextArea, Select, Combobox, MultiCombobox, PhoneInput) in another FieldShell; they render their own.
put text buttons or links in actions; actions are icon buttons that run an operation or open a menu of operations.
use it for a group of controls; FormField's fieldset owns the group case.

controlId.description: id of the control inside; the label, status and helper ids derive from it.

children.description: The control: an input, textarea, select or composite control.

statusMessage.description: Message under the control, styled and announced for `status`.

helperText.description: Supporting copy under the control, after the status message.

actions.description: Icon buttons at the end of the label row, level with the label.

required.description: Shows the required marker on the label.

disabled.description: Dims the label and disables every action.

hideLabel.description: Visually hides the label; it stays the control's accessible name.
